name: open-design
description: Design posters, social posts, slides, landing pages and more with Open Design's skills and 198 design systems.
long_description: Open Design's MCP server for Claude Desktop, running on Desktop's own Node: no Node.js install, no npx, no download on first start. Install the Open Design plugin too for its skills. This extension does not update itself: install the newer .mcpb from the GitHub release to update.

figma_token.title: Figma access token
figma_token.description: Optional. Only needed to pull Figma frames when Figma's own connector isn't connected.

workspace.title: Default design folder
workspace.description: Optional. Used when a chat has no connected folder: designs go in a folder per design under it.
